name: Emissive Volume Rendering
definition: Adds emissive volume support by introducing a volume emitter to a given shape, which is sampled as part of the medium sampling routines in volpath, volpathmis, and prbvolpath integrators.
summary: Emissive Volume Rendering simulates light emission from participating media by integrating volume emission sampling into path tracing, avoiding the performance penalties of direct solid-angle-to-volume PDF conversion.
